items.title: Pages of the West: Canyon Chase Sequence-- Part 2 | Storyboard | Action, Drama
items.summary: A Native American woman and her 2 year old son must flee from oppressive forces through a narrow canyon on horseback, taking place in an alternate late 1800s western setting... complete with metal stallions.Full sequence is already posted, this is just to break down the whole thing into three separate parts for easy viewing on a portfolio.Part 2. Enjoy!
